name: LeaFFMPEG
description: Converta vídeos e mídias do Twitter/X, Discord e links diretos em GIFs otimizados (≤ 8MB) para envio no Discord, com suporte a legendas estilo meme.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data: https://*.twimg.com https://pbs.twimg.com https://abs.twimg.com https://*.discordapp.com https://*.discordapp.net https://*.discord.com; media-src 'self' blob: data: https://*.discordapp.com https://*.discordapp.net https://*.discord.com https://*.twimg.com;
